notes: Adds a real, data-grounded predictive-maintenance model: for vehicles with 2+ historical maintenance records, computes the actual mean interval between that vehicle's own past services (MTBS) and compares current days-since-last-service against it, producing a realistic 'expected next service' estimate instead of generic score thresholds alone. Also merges the fleet health index and predictive failure engines into the dashboard's top-level unified 'System Pulse' card, closing a gap where these more advanced engines were built and used elsewhere but not surfaced in the single unified view. A third real correctness test (hand-verified expected numbers) was added covering the new MTBS logic. Dashcam/video safety and live GPS tracking were explicitly excluded from this round per instruction.
